race.description: Helen Castles Scoop Sullivan Showcase Hcp (C1)
race.comment: Speedy gelding COOL AS TED (1) finally broke the maiden status last start at his seventh attempt, running his rivals off their legs over this distance at Nowra. Should ping straight to the lead again from an inside draw and a repeat performance looks on the cards. TALLINGAS INDIROSE (12) returned from an 18-week spell for a new stable last start and was brave in defeat over 1200m at Echuca. On-pacer who will need a bit of luck getting over from a wide gate but if things go right she is a leading contender. WINTER HAIL (7) last raced five weeks ago when well held over 900m at Albury. Placed at all three runs over this trip. Blinkers on might be a key move. Market watch on FAST 'N' INZAINE (5) first-up from an eight-week let-up for a new stable. Plenty of respect for BACK UP PLAN (4) back for a second campaign off a five-week spell. Both runs to date have been impressive and this is certainly within reach.
